gen-almendra-display-gf-anaheim: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display has letters that never seem to pinch shut. And Anaheim, a rounded sans-serif, packs glyphs into a dense huddle the eye slides through over a whole page.
gen-almendra-display-gf-arsenal: A storybook swagger, with letters that never pinch shut and barely any stroke contrast. Arsenal runs tight, with a gentle dip-pen swell in each stroke and an x-height close to the capitals.
gen-almendra-display-gf-asimovian: Almendra Display is all ornate, literary flourish, with no letter pinched shut. Asimovian draws every letter with a single unbroken line weight, from terminals to junctions, and gives each lowercase a tall body.
gen-almendra-display-gf-changa: A storybook look: letters that never pinch shut, plus a pronounced x-height. Almendra Display does ornate, literary character best, while Changa does modern, clean sturdiness, its lowercase standing like cast iron capitals.
gen-almendra-display-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono reads like nails laid along a ruler, every glyph one width. Almendra Display brings ornate, literary curves up top, and the monospace below keeps everything structured and precise.
gen-almendra-display-gf-genos: Almendra Display never lets a letter pinch shut, and its x-height is pronounced. And Genos, with a high-set midline and glyphs pressed close, gives the page its best quality: a read that never snags.
gen-almendra-display-gf-geom: Geom reads contemporary and approachable, its lowercase rising in a lofty band across the line. And Almendra Display excels at ornate, literary flourish, its letters never pinching shut, and Geom at carrying the sans-serif text beneath.
gen-almendra-display-gf-hammersmith-one: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut. Hammersmith One counters with rounded, cord-like monoline strokes, and the gap between ornate and monoline is the pairing's best quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-jaldi: Almendra Display wears an ornate, literary look, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height pronounced. Jaldi's tightly brushed lines glide down the page, its gaping c always visible.
gen-almendra-display-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Almendra Display opens the page ornate and literary, its letters never pinching shut. Kdam Thmor Pro, a modern sans-serif with bowls that fill the line, sits beneath and lets that flourish stand out.
